timing_note: Approaches are ordered logical passes, not separately measured wall-clock intervals. This log was checkpointed after the complete proofs were written.

approaches.result: Proposition 1 proves that an initial structure with the kappa-cut property contains every surreal of length less than kappa.
approaches.remaining_gap: Embedding-dependent birthday bounds leave long missing cuts outside the saturation hypothesis.

approaches.result: Proposition 2, its odd-prime localization corollary, and a conditional Omitting Types reduction.
approaches.remaining_gap: The type is principal in 2-divisible theories; no covering argument for every non-DOAG theory.

approaches.result: Proposition 3 gives initial dense groups with all coefficient groups R but prescribed nondivisible eventual-coefficient quotient.
approaches.remaining_gap: No claim or proof that all models of one non-DOAG theory have initial copies; saturation of the examples is unproved.

approaches.mechanism: Field residue value and integer-part methods
approaches.result: Propositions 4 and 4.1 give an initial non-real-closed field with real coefficients, rational exponent group, and explicit integer part.
approaches.remaining_gap: No no-integer-part model is constructed for an arbitrary specified non-RCF theory.

approaches.result: Proposition 5 proves set-sized initial hull existence; Z[1/3] illustrates failure of elementary preservation. Compatible embeddings would transfer to a union.
approaches.remaining_gap: Compatibility is not supplied by separate existence; no reflection principle deriving the set-model statement is proved.
